type: PROPOSED APP FEATURE — not implemented, not read by the app
problem: The catalog builder resolves a river's endpoints only in catalog/map_points/<river.state>.json. Two Wyoming reaches run across a state line (Clarks Fork into Montana; North Platte from Colorado), and their natural endpoints are, or would be, in the neighbouring state's registry.
proposal: Let a section endpoint resolve to another state's registry entry, e.g. an optional per-section 'crossStateEndpoints': {"<endpoint name>": "MT"}. No research is repeated; the other state's record stays the single source of truth.
notDone: No MT or CO record was copied into catalog/map_points/WY.json. The affected sections are drafts (research/river-drafts). No change was made to the app or the live site.

otherRegistry.sourceName: Montana FWP Bridger Fishing Access Site 39754495

proposedSection.mileSource: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (NLDI DM from the WY Clarks Fork group)

references.note: WGFD's 'WY/MT State Line' is an egress marker with no facility. The next public take-out with an agency record is Montana FWP's Bridger FAS, already verified in the MT registry (MT river clarks-fork-yst, Bridger→Edgar). A cross-state endpoint lookup would let a WY section end there without copying the MT record.

WGFD lists 'Routt, Colorado' as the uppermost North Platte launch (coordinate in Colorado, lat 40.95). The Colorado package on this box (floateta-colorado-v1.1) has no North Platte point and ref1026 has no CO registry, so there is nothing to reference yet. Proposal only; a future CO pass could verify a Northgate Canyon/Routt NF access, then a cross-state lookup could link it.
